props.name: Zero Power: The Blackest Night
props.skill_information:
Trigger: When Geist is reduced to 0 HP while his Zero Power is full (6).

Effect: Geist expends all of his Zero Power and sacrifices part of his soul. His lesser shadows collapse — and he rises again: HP is restored up to a waning threshold (70% of max, then 70% of the previous threshold each time this triggers) and MP is fully restored. His maximum HP is unchanged.

If his Zero Power is not full when he falls, the darkness fails him — Geist is destroyed for good, and his shadows die with him.
